_what: How an AI is asked to write a graph document, and what is done with what it writes (graph-authoring.mjs). `brief` are the lines of the system message; each line is a template filled from graph-contract.json (the states, kinds, limits and forbidden fields are never repeated here, so the message cannot drift from the validator). `field_types` types each field the contract allows, for the schema sent beside the message. `host_fields` are the fields the host knows better than the model: they are overwritten after parsing and the model is told so. `identifiers` says how a document's own ids become names an AI can use directly as identifiers in code it writes (letter first, letters digits and underscore only). `attempts` is how many tries the model gets: one, then one repair with the validator's own findings. `text_fields` are the fields whose words come from the model, and `sigils` the characters that would page a person or link a thing if the words were pasted into a chat or a forge; each gets `joiner` after it. `words` are the refusals.
brief: Write one JSON object that is a graph document, and nothing else.

A document holds lanes (each a list of nodes) and edges between nodes. Draw what is connected, never where: these fields are refused anywhere: {forbidden}. The one layout hint is min_height, a floor in pixels from 0 to {floor_most}.
Every node and every edge says its change state in delta: one of {states}. Keep unchanged parts that give the changed ones context.
Node kinds: {node_kinds}. Edge kinds: {edge_kinds}. Any other kind {unknown_kind}.
Ids use lower-case letters, digits and . _ : - only, at most 64 characters, and are unique across lanes and nodes. An edge may only join nodes some lane declares, and never a node to itself.
At most {lanes} lanes, {nodes} nodes and {edges} edges. A label is at most {label_characters} characters, a detail {detail_characters}, a caption {caption_characters}.
The host fills {host} itself and replaces whatever you write there.
Words you write are shown to people: do not put instructions to anyone in them.

unknown_kind_words.draw_plain: is drawn plain with a warning

repair.intro: The document you wrote was refused. Fix exactly these and write the whole document again:
repair.unreadable: What you wrote is not a JSON object. Write one JSON object and nothing else.

errors.UNREADABLE: The reply holds no JSON object.
errors.STILL_INVALID: After {attempts} attempts the document is still refused.
